title: Your phone's world tour
hook_variants: Your phone has seen more countries than you have.
No single country can build your phone. Not one.
Your phone flew around the world before you ever touched it.

scenes.say: Your phone has seen more countries than you have.
Designed in one place. Built from parts made everywhere.
Chips from Taiwan. Screens from Korea. Rare metals from Africa and China. Assembly in China or India.
Hundreds of suppliers. Dozens of countries. One tiny device in your hand.
That's why one blocked port or one tariff can change what your phone costs.
Follow Landed Costs. Comment a product and I'll trace it.

caption:
Chips, screens, metals and assembly from all over the world. No single country can build your phone alone. 📱🌍

Comment a product and I'll trace its journey next.
